title: Slow progress from my daytrading bot
author: Must_Dragonfruit
selftext:
This is live schwab data, not delayed or polygon.  At 30 days, the best model will trade live on ibkr.  It will compete against the human based model I created based on my trades. 

I'm building out my fundamentals / stock universe and you're all welcome to use the API for the next six months. 

It includes way way way more data than any free service.
